mapper.sql: announcements.id AS id, announcements.title AS title, announcements.image AS image, announcements.image_url AS imageUrl, announcements.content AS content, announcements.schedule AS schedule, announcements.is_public AS isPublic, announcements.created AS created, CONCAT(IFNULL(creator.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(creator.last_name, '')) AS createdBy, announcements.modified AS modified, CONCAT(IFNULL(modifier.first_name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(modifier.last_name, '')) AS modifiedBy
FROM announcements LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON announcements.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON announcements.modified_by = modifier.id

WHERE announcements.is_active = 1 AND announcements.type = 2
AND ( announcements.title LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR announcements.content LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") )
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE announcements.is_active = 1 AND announcements.type = 2 AND announcements.id = #{id}

SELECT customers.id AS id, customers.name AS name FROM announcement_user_apps INNER JOIN user_apps ON user_apps.id = announcement_user_apps.user_app_id INNER JOIN customers ON customers.user_app_id = user_apps.id WHERE announcement_user_apps.announcement_id = #{announcementId} AND customers.is_active = 1 GROUP BY customers.id, customers.name ORDER BY customers.name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcements ( title, image, image_url, content, schedule, created, created_by, is_public, type, user_type, is_active ) VALUES ( #{announcement.title}, #{announcement.image}, #{announcement.imageUrl}, #{announcement.content}, #{announcement.schedule}, NOW(), #{announcement.createdBy}, #{announcement.isPublic}, #{announcement.type}, #{announcement.userType}, #{announcement.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE announcements SET title = #{announcement.title}, image = #{announcement.image}, image_url = #{announcement.imageUrl}, content = #{announcement.content}, schedule = #{announcement.schedule}, is_public = #{announcement.isPublic}, type = #{announcement.type}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{announcement.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{announcement.id} AND is_active = 1 AND type = 2
UPDATE announcements SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1 AND type = 2
